title: A Trip to Lisbon
text:
Last summer, Anna visited Lisbon with her sister. They took a train from the airport to the city centre. The hotel was small, but the view from the room was beautiful. Every morning, they ate fresh bread and drank coffee on the balcony.

On the third day, they took a boat trip along the river. The guide told them many stories about the old buildings. Anna took many photos, and she said it was the best trip of her life.

paragraph_translations: No verão passado, Anna visitou Lisboa com a irmã. Elas pegaram um trem do aeroporto até o centro da cidade. O hotel era pequeno, mas a vista do quarto era linda. Todas as manhãs, comiam pão fresco e tomavam café na varanda.
No terceiro dia, fizeram um passeio de barco pelo rio. O guia contou muitas histórias sobre os prédios antigos. Anna tirou muitas fotos e disse que foi a melhor viagem da vida dela.
